text:
maya: Hey team — HelixPay just pushed back their bespoke security questionnaire. They specifically want: KMS/HSM attestation, key rotation proof, audit log extracts for last 90 days, and confirmation of retention policy. Their compliance deadline is EOD tomorrow. Can security/infra help compile evidence and a short cover note? :alarm_clock:

julian: We can provide key rotation records and a vendor HSM attestation (we use YubiHSM/CloudKMS combo). Need to confirm whether HelixPay needs signed attestation or just technical evidence screenshots/exports.

maya: They asked for signed vendor attestation + internal rotation logs. Also they want an example of the decrypted audit log entry format (with PII redacted) to show what fields we capture.

oli_infra: I can export audit logs. Quick repro for getting logs from our audit pipeline:

```
# export logs for customer helixpay in iso range
AUDIT_RANGE_START=2025-10-01
AUDIT_RANGE_END=2026-01-31
kubectl -n infra logs -l app=audit-forwarder | jq -c 'select(.customer=="helixpay" and .ts>="'$AUDIT_RANGE_START'" and .ts<="'$AUDIT_RANGE_END'")' > helixpay_audit.ndjson
aws s3 cp helixpay_audit.ndjson s3://redwood-compliance-exports/helixpay/ --acl private
```

oli_infra: I'll scrub PII fields (email, user_id, ip) via jq filter before sharing. Will attach a sample (redacted) entry.

security_engineer: Note: we can provide rotation proof as KMS key versions + rotation timestamps and KMS CMK metadata. For HSM vendor attestation, we have a signed PDF from our vendor dated 2026-02-12. I'll attach and include hash. Also confirm: retention policy is 365 days for audit events by default; some customers have extended export options.

maya: Perfect. Can you confirm the canonical retention policy text I should paste into the questionnaire? They want exact wording for "audit log retention" and "log integrity controls".

julian: Use this text: "Audit logs are retained in immutable, access-controlled storage for 365 days by default. Log ingestion uses signed append-only streams with HMAC verification; export bundles are zipped and checksummed (SHA256). Access to export bundles is restricted via IAM roles and logged in access audit trails." Feel free to adjust tone for the questionnaire.

security_engineer: Also add: "Customer-managed KMS keys supported for Private deployments; for Hosted, we manage CMKs in CloudKMS and can provide rotation/certificate evidence on request. No plaintext key material is stored outside the HSM-backed KMS." 

maya: Helpful. Oli — can you paste the redacted sample audit entry when ready? We should avoid sample values that reveal internal hostnames.

oli_infra: Pasted sample (redacted):

```
{
  "ts": "2026-01-15T14:32:07Z",
  "customer": "helixpay",
  "event": "model.infer.request",
  "request_id": "REDACTED-XXXX",
  "user_role": "platform_service",
  "action": "invoke_model",
  "model": "redwood/gpt-3.5x",
  "latency_ms": 123,
  "auth_method": "token:kms-encrypted",
  "outcome": "success",
  "checksum": "sha256:REDACTED"
}
```

maya: Great, that should satisfy their "example log" ask.

julian: One more: HelixPay asked whether we can provide a time-of-compromise detection statement. We should be explicit: we do alerting on anomalous access patterns and will provide timeline exports on request under a support contract.

maya: I'll draft the response and attach: 1) vendor HSM attestation (signed), 2) rotation log export CSV, 3) redacted audit ndjson sample, 4) canonical retention + integrity statement, 5) note on incident timeline support. Target: send by 16:00 PT today. Anyone object?

security_engineer: No objections. I'll sign the cover note and include the vendor statement hash.

oli_infra: I’ll upload scrubbed audit bundle to the exports bucket and DM the download link to legal and maya.

reminder-bot: Reminder: HelixPay bespoke questionnaire due in ~22 hours. :bell:

maya: Thanks all — I'll assemble and submit. If HelixPay comes back asking for deeper cryptographic proofs (e.g., HSM slot-level attestation), we'll escalate to infra-sec and legal.
